title: Satin Brass Toilet Paper Stand - 26-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Toilet Tissue Holder Stand (Contemporary), Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach without drilling into tile or crowded walls—this freestanding toilet paper stand is assembled in the U — available in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. S.A. and designed for everyday bathroom use.

Crafted from solid brass with a heavy base, it stays put and adds a crisp, contemporary touch to modern bathroom hardware layouts.

  • Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Protects your floors: felt pad helps prevent scratching on any surface
  • Built for daily use: solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Finishes that coordinate: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Specs

  • Product type: Freestanding toilet tissue stand (toilet paper stand)
  • Overall size: 26 in high
  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 5.5 x 26 x 6 in
  • Material: Solid brass
  • Mounting: Freestanding
  • Included items: Toilet tissue stand
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces to create a coordinated look.
meta_description: Freestanding toilet paper stand, 26-inch tall solid brass tissue holder with heavy base and felt pad—ideal when wall space is limited. Limited warranty.
